question: Which of the following languages belongs to the Classical Language category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanskrit.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanskrit **is an** ancient language** that has a rich history and cultural significance in India.
 
• It is one of the **oldest languages** in the world and is known for its complex** grammar and vocabulary.**
 
• The **Classical Language category** is a status given to a language in India that meets certain criteria, including a** long history, literary tradition, and cultural significance**.
 
• **Sanskrit **is one of the **22 languages **that has been given this status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pali **is another ancient language that is closely associated with **Buddhism**.

 
 
• It was the language used to **record the teachings of the Buddha**, and is still used in some Buddhist texts today.
 
 
 
• **Prakrit** is a group of ancient languages that were **spoken in India before** the rise of Sanskrit.
 
 
• These languages were used in** literature, poetry, and drama,** and some of their features can still be seen in modern Indian languages.
 
 
 
• **Hindi** is a **modern language** that is widely spoken in India today.
 
 
• It is derived from **Sanskrit and other languages**, and has its own unique grammar and vocabulary.
